_doc: Edge Discovery — Phase S1 RETEST selection-effect. Measure-only. Re-measures the spine's selected-vs-rejected RETEST effect (F-002, stale/pre-intrabar) under the GOVERNING intrabar_fixed + 12bps standard, pooled BY EFFECT (not raw entries) across crypto-6, decomposed by reject-reason class. Consumes the RETEST_REPLAY telemetry wired in S0. No magic numbers in Python.
_reason_class_note: Folds RETEST_REPLAY.reject_reason into selection-skill classes. SESSION is the F-017-null / F-006b-dominant lever (rejects are off-session by construction → cannot be session-matched). SCORE/ZONE rejects are IN an allowed session → the genuine selection-skill classes. Anything else → OTHER.
